pending_commit.commit_message: UPSTREAM: ec/google: Detect keyboard backlight at runtime This enables adding the backlight driver to boards that may or may not come with a keyboard backlight function. It's the responsibility of the EC to report if that feature exists, but that's not a big extra burden given that it already keeps track of everything else related to the backlight. UPSTREAM: AGESA binaryPI: Consolidate and fix sleep states SSFG was meant to be used as a mask to enable sleep states _S1 thru _S4. However as a logical instead of bitwise 'and' operation was used, all the states were enabled if only one was marked available. State _S3 is now set conditionally if HAVE_ACPI_RESUME=y. For pi/hudson this had been fixed already preprocessor. Note that all boards had SSFG == 0x0D that previously enabled ACPI S3 sleep state even when it was not available. States _S1 and _S2 still appear enabled in ASL/AML but may not actually work. TEST: 'cat /sys/power/state' and notice choice 'mem' was removed from the list of available sleep states. BUG=none BRANCH=none TEST=none Change-Id: I0b5d8a617af02f3901304932d833f1d6369682db Signed-off-by: Patrick Georgi <pgeorgi@google.com> Original-Commit-Id: 390ba044dcd650e37340f1ddee98bedf1096e76d Original-Change-Id: I27d616871c1771f0c87d8fba23d4ce1569607765 Original-Signed-off-by: Kysti Mlkki <kyosti.malkki@gmail.com> Original-Reviewed-on: https://review.coreboot.org/21091 Original-Tested-by: build bot (Jenkins) <no-reply@coreboot.org> Original-Reviewed-by: Marc Jones <marc@marcjonesconsulting.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/628162 Commit-Ready: Patrick Georgi <pgeorgi@chromium.org> Tested-by: Patrick Georgi <pgeorgi@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Patrick Georgi <pgeorgi@chromium.org>

UPSTREAM: soc/intel/apollolake: Provide option to use Common MP Init This patch provides the option to use the common CPU Mp Init code by selecting a Config Token. CONFIG_SOC_INTEL_COMMON_BLOCK_CPU_MPINIT config token can be selected to use the Common MP Init Code, also where CPU MP Init is done before FSP-S Init. And if the config token is not selected, the old way of implementation will exist, where MP Init is been done after FSP-S.
